description: Every request at one address, newest first, with its status, days to close or days open, and the agency's resolution text, plus counts by problem. The address is converted to the City's spelling as in find_district. With no dates, covers every request since 2020. From BoardStat (BetaNYC, NYC Open Data, 2020 on); not an official City report. 311 counts are reports, not problems; 'closed' is not 'fixed'.

borough.description: Needed when the same address exists in several boroughs.

community_district.description: Optional: the district (BoardStat id) to use when the address straddles a line. Default: the one with the most requests there.

data_as_of.description: For the next page, next_page.data_as_of; a page from a newer build is refused.

last_days.description: The last N days of data, ending on the newest request's day (not today).

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0); for the next page, next_page.offset.

problems.description: BoardStat problem names, e.g. ['HEAT/HOT WATER']; any case.

name: address_history
